description: Hacker News Comments & Threads: one Hacker News story or comment by id or news.ycombinator.com URL with its direct replies (up to 8 per call, next_cursor for more), deleted and dead replies skipped. Per item the text as plain text, author, score, reply count, parent and time in the shared social schema. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (a reply offset).

id.description: The story or comment: a Hacker News item id (a positive whole number) or a news.ycombinator.com/item?id= URL.

limit.description: Direct replies wanted, 1-50 (default 10); one call returns at most 8, next_cursor pages through the rest.

name: hackernews_thread
title: Hacker News thread
